name: Nijou Tsukune
source:
[b]Crossdressing little sister with a secret brother complex[/b]

Hatsune’s younger sister and a member of the fashion design club.
While Hatsune dresses as a gyaru, she goes in the opposite direction—she dresses as a boy. People around her see her as a supportive sister who shares her brother’s interest in fashion and self-expression.

But in reality, her choice to crossdress stems from a deeper, more personal feeling: Why didn’t my brother, who’s trying to become his ideal gyaru, come to me—the girl closest to him—for help? Her crossdressing is actually an expression of these complicated feelings toward her brother.

In truth, she’s a full-blown brocon—a girl absolutely obsessed with her big brother—but no one around her has any idea. And she has no intention of letting them find out.


•Her birthday it's the same day as the "Dat that leads to good connections."
•She is good at: Sports, studying.  
•She is bad at: Being active on days off.

[i]"Nii-san, you're not overdoing it again, are you?"[/i]
